newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end higher on cash bond buying by investors.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end higher on cash bond buying by investors.

text.p: The key March Japanese government bond futures contract ended higher on Thursday, as buying of cash JGBs by investors led to a flurry of short-covering.
November machinery orders data, released in the afternoon, came within market expectations and had little effect on the market, traders said.
Japan's private-sector machinery orders fell 9.7 percent in November from the previous month to 1.23 trillion yen, the Economic Planning Agency (EPA) said.
The March ended at 126.08, up from Tuesday's 125.73. The Tokyo market was closed for a holiday on Wednesday.
